questions.scenario: An EC2 instance uses the default VPC resolver. Which address is available for DNS queries in a VPC whose CIDR starts at 10.20.0.0?

options.text: The VPC base address plus two, and the link-local resolver address.
The NAT gateway private IP only.

questions.explanation: Route 53 Resolver is available through the VPC-provided resolver endpoints, including the VPC base plus two. Learn more in [Route 53 Resolver](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver.html).

questions.scenario: orders.internal resolves in the tooling VPC but returns NXDOMAIN in the production VPC. The same private hosted zone should serve both. What should be checked first?

options.text: Whether the production VPC has a NAT gateway.
Whether the private hosted zone is associated with the production VPC.
Whether the record is also in a public hosted zone.
Whether the database has a public IP.

questions.explanation: Private hosted zone answers are visible only to associated VPCs and connected resolver designs. Learn more in [Route 53 Resolver](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver.html).

questions.scenario: A Secrets Manager interface endpoint exists, but applications still resolve the public service hostname to public addresses. Which endpoint setting is the likely missing link?

options.text: Private DNS for the interface endpoint.

questions.explanation: Private DNS maps the standard regional service hostname to private endpoint addresses inside the VPC. Learn more in [Route 53 Resolver](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver.html).

questions.scenario: On-premises clients must resolve names in an AWS private hosted zone. Which Resolver endpoint direction receives those DNS queries into the VPC?
questions.explanation: Inbound Resolver endpoints accept DNS queries from connected networks into the VPC resolver. Learn more in [Hybrid DNS with Route 53 Resolver](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver-forwarding-outbound-queries.html).

questions.scenario: A hybrid name times out from on-premises but resolves inside the VPC. Which evidence should the team collect?

options.text: Resolver endpoint IP reachability over UDP and TCP 53.
Increase an unrelated S3 lifecycle retention period.
Resolver query logs for the request.

questions.explanation: Endpoint reachability, forwarding rules, associations, and query logs cover the hybrid DNS path. Learn more in [Hybrid DNS with Route 53 Resolver](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver-forwarding-outbound-queries.html).
